calls.statement:
-- Get all members contacted (not in holdout) for campaign 19
-- Then sum their spending between May 4 and May 24, 2026
WITH contacted_members AS (
  -- Get all members in the mailing list
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM dim_member m
  WHERE m.is_current = true
  EXCEPT
  -- Subtract those in the holdout
  SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_spending
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
INNER JOIN contacted_members cm ON m.member_id = cm.member_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

-- Final answer: members contacted for Spring Garden Launch 2026 and their spending May 4-24
WITH contacted_members AS (
  -- Get all members in the mailing list for campaign 19
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM dim_member m
  WHERE m.is_current = true
  EXCEPT
  -- Subtract those in the holdout
  SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM contacted_members) AS members_contacted,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS spending_may_4_to_24
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
INNER JOIN contacted_members cm ON m.member_id = cm.member_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

-- Verify contacted member count for campaign 19
SELECT 
  c.mailing_list_size,
  c.holdout_size,
  (c.mailing_list_size - c.holdout_size) AS members_contacted
FROM dim_campaign c
WHERE c.campaign_id = 19

-- Get the total spending of members contacted for campaign 19 during May 4-24, 2026
SELECT 
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_spending
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
WHERE m.is_current = true
  AND f.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' 
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
  AND m.member_id NOT IN (
    SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 19
  )
